evidence:
PASS for the assigned structural/semantic row only. Paths below are relative to the frozen task unless stated otherwise. The workbook's Quality Checks!D38 and Internal Quality Checks!D38 ask whether later dimensions assume pristine shared state; the frozen quality-checks.md:153-154 recommends observed/state-relative expectations. tests/test.sh:203-225 runs gates before scored dimensions with --max-concurrent-agent 1, and the restart helper reuses DB_PATH (109,165); the app is genuinely shared rather than reset between dimensions.
The constraints gate creates only its unique requisition/PENDING offer and leaves them in place (tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:5; judge.toml:23-26). Functional explicitly acknowledges those records, prohibits using/mutating other judges' controls, and creates dedicated ample-budget requisitions with session suffixes (tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:13). Its facts are per-record before/after comparisons rather than global log counts (19); P6 uses independent budgets, expressly without dependence on seeded remaining room (39); B protocols use owned eligible hires and distinct operation keys (53). Restart compares actual captured records and imported seed IDs only if imported (49; functional/judge.toml:902), rather than restoring a pristine roster. The seeded arithmetic example at functional/judge.toml:461 is prefaced 'Before mutations'; no dimension is instructed to mutate that seeded requisition, while the operative P4 headroom comparison uses the observed initial budget. No prior-dimension mutation dependency was found there.
Polish performs its own dimension-specific creation (tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:7), creates dedicated current committed hires, and says 'Other judges' records are not controls' (10). All four polish criteria use dedicated eligible/current targets, separate successful controls, and actual saved operations (polish/judge.toml:23,32,41,50); earlier supersession/rescission cannot consume their targets. Visual makes its unique gate record, then reviews current/available surfaces read-only and explicitly must not depend on another judge's exact data (tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:7-10). Its five criteria grade observed craft without fixed row counts, statuses, balances or a pristine screenshot. tests/app_context.md:21 allows absent operational demonstration rows.
Adversarial reasoning: a conforming app where earlier functional work has left many superseded/rescinded offers, extra audit entries and changed headrooms still supplies new Polish-owned controls and current visual surfaces; no later expectation demands old seed totals. A broken app serving a cached pristine seed or reusing another dimension's successful creation cannot satisfy each dimension's uniquely named creation plus fresh-context exact-value readback (each scored prompt's gate), and cannot earn recovery credit from already-settled inherited targets. These are source-based counterexample analyses, not executed mutant runs.
Supplemental runtime observation: local/batch-ui.cjs executes initial UI commit, an independent pair's stale-refusal/new-key recovery, then another independent pair's lost-response/retry and Auditor readback in one running app/database. local/batch-ui/results.json reports all five observations passing and no browser errors.
